# Data Source fpolicy_external_engine

Create/Update/Delete FPolicy engine configuration resources

## Related ONTAP commands

```commandline
* fpolicy policy external-engine create
* fpolicy policy external-engine modify
* fpolicy policy external-engine delete
```

## Supported Platforms

- On-perm ONTAP system 9.6 or higher
- Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP
- The parameters `max_server_requests`, `resiliency`, `format`, `server_progress_timeout`, `buffer_size`, `ssl_option`, `status_request_interval`, `status_request_interval`, `certificate` and `request_cancel_timeout` can only be used in ONTAP 9.11 or higher
- The parameter `keep_alive_interval` can only be used in ONTAP 9.13 or higher
- The parameters `session_timeout` and `max_connection_retries` can only be used in ONTAP 9.17 or higher

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netapp-ontap_protocols_fpolicy_external_engine" "protocols_fpolicy_external_engine" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "cluster1"
  name           = "test_engine"
  svm_name       = "svm1"
  port           = 9002
  primary_servers = [
    "10.10.10.20",
    "10.10.10.21",
  ]
  secondary_servers = [
    "10.10.11.22",
    "10.10.11.26"
  ]
  type = "asynchronous"
  format = "xml"
  keep_alive_interval     = "PT4M"
  session_timeout         = "PT16S"
  request_cancel_timeout  = "PT32S"
  request_abort_timeout   = "PT2M"
  status_request_interval = "PT16S"
  server_progress_timeout = "PT1M20S"
  max_server_requests    = 850
  max_connection_retries = 9
  ssl_option = "no_auth"  # Options: "no_auth", "server_auth", "mutual_auth"
  certificate = {
    name          = "fpolicy_cert"
    serial_number = "1234567892"
    ca            = "fpolicy_test_ca"
  }
  buffer_size = {
    send_buffer = 1224000
    recv_buffer = 4294304
  }
  resiliency = {
    enabled            = false
    directory_path     = "/dir"
    retention_duration = "PT4M"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `name` (String) FPolicy external engine name
- `port` (Number) Port number of the FPolicy server application
- `primary_servers` (List of String) The primary FPolicy servers to which the node sends notifications for a given FPolicy policy
- `svm_name` (String) SVM name

### Optional
- `buffer_size` (Attributes) Specifies the send and receive buffer size of the connected socket for the FPolicy server (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buffer_size))
- `certificate` (Attributes) Provides details about certificate used to authenticate the FPolicy server (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificate))
- `format` (String) The format for the notification messages sent to the FPolicy servers
- `keep_alive_interval` (String) The ISO-8601 interval time for a storage appliance to send Keep Alive message to an FPolicy server
- `max_connection_retries` (Number) The maximum number of attempts to reconnect to the FPolicy server
- `max_server_requests` (Number) The maximum number of outstanding requests for the FPolicy server
- `request_abort_timeout` (String) The ISO-8601 timeout duration for a screen request to be aborted by a storage appliance
- `request_cancel_timeout` (String) The ISO-8601 timeout duration for a screen request to be processed by an FPolicy server
- `resiliency` (Attributes) When primary and secondary servers are down or unresponsive, file access events are stored in the storage controller under the specified resiliency-directory-path, resiliency can be enabled only if type is asynchronous (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resiliency))
- `secondary_servers` (List of String) Send file access events for a given FPolicy policy
- `server_progress_timeout` (String) The ISO-8601 timeout duration in which a throttled FPolicy server must complete at least one screen request
- `session_timeout` (String) The interval after which a new session ID is sent to the FPolicy server during reconnection attempts
- `ssl_option` (String) The SSL option for external communication with the FPolicy server
- `status_request_interval` (String) The ISO-8601 interval time for a storage appliance to query a status request from an FPolicy server
- `type` (String) Determines what ONTAP does after sending notifications to FPolicy servers

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) FPolicy external engine ID
